Tyrese Maxey scored the 76ers' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 17 times in 82 starts, or 21% of the games they started. Joel Embiid was next with 16. The 76ers made the game's first field goal in 49% of their 94 games and won 53% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
